In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present study did not find evidence for substitutability of wheel running for sucrose, but did find evidence for substituting sucrose for wheel running.
, in the present study, wheel running did not substitute for or reinforce sucrose consumption.
wheel running and sucrose are both reinforcers that are substitutable for one another, but that wheel running is not as reinforcing as sucrose.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the value of wheel running is independent of its cost in terms of food deprivation and that wheel running is not an essential component of the reinforcing value of sucrose.
wheel running and food are not perfect substitutes for each other, but wheel running is a good substitute for food.
the value of wheel running is not a function of its substitutability for food, but rather is a function of its value as an activity reinforcer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the reinforcing effects of wheel running and food are independent.
the effects of food deprivation on behavior are not limited to food-related behavior; food deprivation also affects behavior maintained by non-food reinforcers.
